title: scrubber_main validator — input
description: Wraps a candidate scrubber_main JSON for validation. Pure-compute; the actual scrubber_main schema is referenced by name and supplied via context (the adapter resolves it from registries/schemas/).

payload.description: The raw value to validate (typically a scrubber_main JSON object).

schema.description: JSON Schema to validate against. When omitted, the adapter is expected to resolve atlases/inversion/registries/schemas/scrubber_main.schema.json and inject it here.

strict.description: When true, warnings are upgraded to errors.
